name: open-appsec
description: Inspect and block malicious requests with the open-appsec agent.

USE_OPENAPPSEC.help: Activate open-appsec request inspection for this site.
USE_OPENAPPSEC.label: Use open-appsec

OPENAPPSEC_API.help: Base URL (scheme + host[:port]) of the open-appsec judge sidecar, e.g. http://bw-openappsec. The judge listens on port 80 so open-appsec host rules match without a port suffix.
OPENAPPSEC_API.label: Open-appsec Api

OPENAPPSEC_FAIL_MODE.help: Choose whether requests are allowed or denied when the open-appsec judge is unreachable.
OPENAPPSEC_FAIL_MODE.label: Open-appsec Fail Mode

OPENAPPSEC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.help: Milliseconds to wait for a TCP connection to the judge before giving up (then OPENAPPSEC_FAIL_MODE applies).
OPENAPPSEC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.label: Open-appsec Connect Timeout

OPENAPPSEC_READ_TIMEOUT.help: Milliseconds to wait for the judge's verdict once connected; covers sending the replay and reading the answer.
OPENAPPSEC_READ_TIMEOUT.label: Open-appsec Read Timeout

OPENAPPSEC_ERROR_COOLDOWN.help: Seconds during which a worker skips the judge after an error (fail mode applied immediately, no timeout per request). 0 disables the cooldown.
OPENAPPSEC_ERROR_COOLDOWN.label: Open-appsec Error Cooldown

OPENAPPSEC_INSPECT_BODY.help: Replay the request body to the judge. Set to no to inspect headers, URI and query string only.
OPENAPPSEC_INSPECT_BODY.label: Open-appsec Inspect Body

OPENAPPSEC_MAX_BODY_SIZE.help: Bodies larger than this many bytes are not replayed (headers only). 0 means no limit.
OPENAPPSEC_MAX_BODY_SIZE.label: Open-appsec Max Body Size

OPENAPPSEC_EXCLUDED_URIS.help: Space-separated PCRE regexes matched against the request path (no query string); matching requests skip open-appsec, e.g. ^/healthz$ ^/webhooks/.
OPENAPPSEC_EXCLUDED_URIS.label: Open-appsec Excluded Uris

OPENAPPSEC_EXCLUDED_METHODS.help: Space-separated HTTP methods that skip open-appsec, e.g. OPTIONS HEAD.
OPENAPPSEC_EXCLUDED_METHODS.label: Open-appsec Excluded Methods

OPENAPPSEC_STRIP_HEADERS.help: Space-separated request header names removed from the copy sent to the judge, e.g. authorization cookie. Privacy at the cost of detection on those headers.
OPENAPPSEC_STRIP_HEADERS.label: Open-appsec Strip Headers

OPENAPPSEC_CANARY_INTERVAL.help: Seconds between enforcement canaries: a known-bad request sent to the judge to prove it still blocks. 0 disables the canary.
OPENAPPSEC_CANARY_INTERVAL.label: Open-appsec Canary Interval

OPENAPPSEC_CANARY_FAIL.help: When the canary reports that the judge is no longer enforcing (it accepted a known-bad request), treat every request as a judge error so OPENAPPSEC_FAIL_MODE applies.
OPENAPPSEC_CANARY_FAIL.label: Open-appsec Canary Fail

OPENAPPSEC_EVENTS_DIR.help: Directory inside the web UI container where the judge's agent log directory (/var/log/nano_agent) is mounted read-only. Feeds the open-appsec events view. Empty disables it.
OPENAPPSEC_EVENTS_DIR.label: Open-appsec Events Dir

OPENAPPSEC_POLICY_PATH.help: Path inside the web UI container of the judge's local_policy.yaml (shared volume, writable by the UI, JSON syntax). Enables exceptions and per-service mode from the web UI. Empty disables it.
OPENAPPSEC_POLICY_PATH.label: Open-appsec Policy Path
